expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.tapa==='karry' && S.m1===1 && S.m2===0.5 && S.running===false && S.t===0 && S.v===0 && S.s===0 && S.done===false ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: cart on the table, m1 = 1,0 kg, m2 = 0,50 kg, at rest, not running (must run before any setup)
no sliders: the situation and the two masses are selects

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===4 && L[0]==='karry,kaksi' && L[1]==='0.3,0.5,1,1.5' && L[2]==='0.3,0.5,0.6,1' && L[3]==='0.2,0.4,1' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: situation, mass m1, mass m2, speed

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='m1,m2,tapa' && P.m1.unit==='kg' && P.m2.unit==='kg' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares tapa, m1 (kg) and m2 (kg)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const n=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth<500; return c.width===600 && (n ? c.height>400 : c.height===400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600x400 on a wide screen, taller on a phone where the panels stack
